Standard containers remain the route where HYLE cannot supply a distinct layout, complexity, ownership or failure contract; Container does not promise full std, Boost or Folly API parity.
Tokenizer automata, KV or device cache policy, blocking service, compressed rank/select structures and model-specific storage remain higher-layer owners.
The product is C++23 source, static and shared delivery for compatible C++ toolchains without a Native FFI, C API or stable cross-toolchain C++ ABI.

modules.scope: Resolve only the three retained util-runtime v4 blockers: erased argument transport, the private Windows demangle fixture include prerequisite, and the native long-symbol fallback assertion; then complete the previously selected P0 and delivery gates.
modules.non_goals: New capability families; util_core or frozen dependency changes; Sched, IO, Compute or Graph work; unregister/unload/drain; Native FFI/C API; P1 timing; shared closure, selector or build-system redesign.
known_limitations: Registry is a process-local startup registry with one-way freeze; it does not own dynamic-module unregister, unload, drain or quiescence, so the host must retire borrowed creators before unloading their image.
EntryView, FrozenView and cached Creator handles borrow Registry-owned immutable storage; the Registry must outlive them, and replaced entries remain alive until Registry destruction.

Demangling is a best-effort cold diagnostic facility and may return the exact input after platform rejection, OOM or ambiguous truncation; arbitrary ABI name quality and cross-process DbgHelp coordination are not promised.

The P0 certificate covers complexity and normal-path allocation, lock, metadata and forwarding structure; it makes no P1 timing, Native FFI, cross-toolchain C++ ABI, Formal-performance or universal SOTA claim.
reopen_triggers: A named real consumer reproduces a Registry forwarding, exception, entry, allocator or image-lifetime, concurrent-publication, demangle-completeness, OOM or natural C++ API-usability defect.
A real dynamic-plugin consumer proves that generic unregister, drain or quiescence belongs in util-runtime rather than in the host policy owner.
The public API, layout, algorithm, complexity, normal-path cost, direct dependency, component identity or source, static or shared delivery shape changes.
A real profile promotes Registry or demangle to P1 or P2, or a mature same-contract peer proves a better complexity class or reproducible material consumer advantage.
A supported compiler, standard library, ABI demangler, Windows DbgHelp or sanitizer runtime changes semantics relied on by this round.

modules.scope: Preserve the complete concurrent map, set and vector product while equalizing allocator/resource and membership semantics for the frozen read-mostly P1 workload, then replay affected correctness, delivery, documentation and red-team gates.
modules.non_goals: New concurrent capabilities, public API, layout, reclamation, shard, algorithm or default allocator changes; queues, wait/service policy, Native FFI or C API, common instrument changes and Formal certification.
known_limitations: The P1 claim covers one frozen eight-worker read-mostly membership workload on W1-WIN; exact superiority is inconclusive and no all-operation, cross-platform or Formal SOTA claim is made.
Custom Alloc, Hash and Eq policies can be called concurrently by different shards and must themselves satisfy the documented concurrency contract.
Node address stability is limited to the documented guard lifetime; destruction requires external quiescence, and the default node map trades retained old tables for a zero read-side reclamation tax.
The factor is a private build and dependency boundary behind the C++ Container product, not a Native FFI, C API or stable cross-toolchain C++ ABI.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer reproduces a concurrent map, set or vector correctness, security, publication, reclamation, lifetime, OOM or natural C++ API-usability defect, or proves a missing common concurrent-container capability.
A public API or layout, shard, table, reclamation or progress algorithm, allocator policy, dependency graph or source, static or shared delivery shape changes.
The mem_reclaim contract used by the reclaiming node-map route changes in a way that affects lifetime, synchronization or cost.
Qualified same-contract or real-consumer evidence proves a material regression, or a mature peer proves a better complexity class for an admitted concurrent workload.

modules.scope: Rename the internal factor to container_text while preserving public hyle::container text/path/Unicode APIs, equalize the frozen safe Unicode peer contract, and replay affected correctness, delivery, symbol, documentation and red-team gates.
modules.non_goals: New text capabilities, public header, namespace, API, algorithm, provider or default behavior changes; owning strings, locale, normalization, grapheme, regex or tokenizer policy; Native FFI or C API; common instrument changes; Formal certification.
known_limitations: The P1 claim covers one frozen safe UTF-8-to-UTF-16 caller-buffer workload on W1-WIN; it is not an all-text, cross-platform or Formal SOTA certificate.
StringView and lookup results are borrowed; UTF input and output are caller-owned, undeclared overlap is unsupported, and output-too-small performs no partial conversion.
Container Text deliberately does not own locale, normalization, grapheme segmentation, regex, tokenizer automata, filesystem IO or a general owning-string policy.
simdutf is a private implementation provider, and the factor is a private build boundary behind the C++ Container product without a Native FFI, C API or stable cross-toolchain C++ ABI.
reopen_triggers: A named consumer reproduces a borrowed-text, path, interner or Unicode correctness, security, lifetime, OOM or natural C++ API-usability defect, or proves a missing common Container-owned text capability.
A public API or layout, Unicode error or complete-write semantic, provider or ISA route, allocator, dependency graph or source, static or shared delivery shape changes.
An adopted simdutf or Highway update changes semantics, code generation, licensing or delivery on a used Container Text path.
Qualified same-contract or real-consumer evidence proves a material regression, or a mature peer proves a better complexity class for an admitted text workload.
